name: Jougasaki Kozue
source:
Inclination: Anal
Interest: Cooking, Supermarket time sales
Likes: Parents
Dislikes: Prejudice, Herself

A 1st year student with blonde and a beautiful face that is unforgettable after just one look.
She absolutely hates being looked down upon by others so she acts in a very aloof way, however she doesn't mince words and has an abrasive way of speaking.
Though she is rich that wasn't always the case as her father's company suddenly came into a huge profit. So occasionally she falls back into her pre-wealth ways, her penchant for time sales being one of them.

Unusual Ability: Honest One's Mouth
Anyone she kisses cannot lie,  even false information due to hypnosis is powerless before her ability.
